newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas rallies strongly as April rolls.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas rallies strongly as April rolls.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market rallied strongly on Wednesday, the last day of the April contract, with the front months showing particular strength.

A major buyer appeared looking for prompt and April gas, a broker said, and this had a galvanising effect on the futures market. And the fact that the April contract rolled also boosted activity, with 25 Exchanges for Physical done as well as a single trade on the April contract.

May through August also rose considerably, although the strength was most marked at the front. April, May, June and July all traded for the last time at 10 pence a therm, but as the market had previously been in contango, near-month prices rose faster than outer months to reach the same closing price.
"There's been a fundamental change," said a broker, who added that the market has been going down for so long and has gone so far that "I wouldn't be surprised if it rallies further forward."
A total of 165 lots were traded, with deals done in 8 of the 12 contract months, April through August and January through March.
